label: ESTIMATE, not a measurement
method: List-schedule replay of UNIT_DATA durations over the cargo metadata package graph (see headstart-summarize.sh cmd_replay for the unit rules) at the given job count, priority = observed start order. baseline: an rmeta edge is ready at the dependency frontend end; no_rmeta_wait: an rmeta edge is ready when the dependency starts, the most a metadata-pipelining change could give. realistic_saving = baseline - no_rmeta_wait, both from the same model, so model error largely cancels. Feature-variant units are grouped conservatively.
